confirmed_task:
Open Project Gutenberg eBook 1342, Pride and Prejudice. Report the author, Release Date, Last Update, language, and whether EPUB3, Plain Text (accessible), and Download HTML (zip) are available.

Stopping condition: Stop after the four metadata fields and availability of all three named formats have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use the Release Date and Last Update labels on the Project Gutenberg page; do not substitute the novel's original publication date.
- Check only the three specifically named format labels.
- Do not download any ebook file.
- Preserve displayed dates and format labels exactly.

items.criterion: Access Project Gutenberg eBook 1342 page (Pride and Prejudice)
items.description: Navigate to the Project Gutenberg page for eBook #1342 (URL may be https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1342) and use that page as the source. Full credit if the agent clearly relies on the eBook 1342 page metadata. Also award full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt to access the page but cannot due to external issues (site down, CAPTCHA, network/region blocking, rendering failure) and explicitly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses another Gutenberg mirror/page but clearly indicates it is for eBook 1342. No credit if metadata is taken from a different book/page or is unsupported/hallucinated.

Report the author as shown on the Project Gutenberg eBook 1342 page. Full credit for exact author name as displayed. If the page cannot be accessed due to external issues, full credit if the agent clearly states it cannot verify the author because the page is inaccessible (and does not guess). Partial credit for minor formatting differences that do not change identity if clearly the same author. No credit for wrong author or for substituting non-page info when the page is accessible.

Report the 'Release Date' exactly as labeled/displayed on the Project Gutenberg page (do not substitute original publication date). Full credit if the Release Date value is captured exactly (including month/day/year formatting and any bracketed text if present). If the page cannot be accessed due to external issues, full credit if the agent clearly states it cannot verify the Release Date due to inaccessibility (and does not guess). Partial credit if correct date but not exact displayed formatting. No credit if the agent uses the novel's publication date or an incorrect/unsupported date when the page is accessible.

Report the 'Last Update' exactly as labeled/displayed on the Project Gutenberg page. Full credit if the Last Update value is captured exactly as displayed. If the page cannot be accessed due to external issues, full credit if the agent clearly states it cannot verify Last Update due to inaccessibility (and does not guess). Partial credit if the correct date but formatting differs. No credit if omitted, incorrect, or fabricated when the page is accessible.

Report the language field as shown on the Project Gutenberg page. Full credit for exact language value. If the page cannot be accessed due to external issues, full credit if the agent clearly states it cannot verify language due to inaccessibility (and does not guess). Partial credit if meaning is correct but wording differs when the page clearly shows the language. No credit if wrong or missing when the page is accessible.

Verify and report whether the format label 'EPUB3' is available on the Project Gutenberg page. Full credit if the agent explicitly records availability (available/not available) based only on the 'EPUB3' label and does not download files. If the page/format list cannot be accessed or rendered due to external issues, full credit if the agent states it cannot verify EPUB3 availability (and does not guess). Partial credit if the agent checks EPUB but not specifically EPUB3 when the page is accessible. No credit if the agent checks other formats instead or guesses despite accessible evidence.

items.criterion: Check availability of format: Plain Text (accessible)
items.description: Verify and report whether the format label 'Plain Text (accessible)' is available on the Project Gutenberg page. Full credit if the agent explicitly records availability based only on that exact label and does not download files. If the page/format list cannot be accessed or rendered due to external issues, full credit if the agent states it cannot verify this format’s availability (and does not guess). Partial credit if the agent reports plain text availability but misses the '(accessible)' distinction when the page is accessible. No credit for checking other text formats or guessing despite accessible evidence.

items.criterion: Check availability of format: Download HTML (zip)
items.description: Verify and report whether the format label 'Download HTML (zip)' is available on the Project Gutenberg page. Full credit if the agent explicitly records availability based only on that exact label and does not download files. If the page/format list cannot be accessed or rendered due to external issues, full credit if the agent states it cannot verify this format’s availability (and does not guess). Partial credit if the agent reports HTML availability but not the '(zip)' variant when the page is accessible. No credit if the agent checks other HTML links or guesses despite accessible evidence.

items.criterion: Respect stopping condition and constraints (no downloads; only named formats; stop after recording)
items.description: Full credit if the agent (a) does not download any ebook file, (b) uses the 'Release Date' and 'Last Update' labels on the Gutenberg page when accessible, (c) checks/reports only the three specified format labels (EPUB3, Plain Text (accessible), Download HTML (zip)), and (d) stops after recording the four metadata fields and availability statuses (or after clearly stating it cannot verify due to external access blockers). Partial credit if the agent includes minor extra navigation or minor extra commentary but still complies with no-download and uses correct labeled dates when accessible. No credit if the agent downloads a file, substitutes the novel’s publication date for Release Date/Last Update when the page is accessible, or reports other formats as part of the required output instead of the named ones.
